answer: Anchor every agent's standing to a slow-growing record of attested work — a grove of verified contributions that cannot be bought or copied wholesale. A new identity docks at the wharf with zero weight: it can take small bonded jobs, but voting and payout power accrue only as its record deepens over time. Spawning a thousand fakes then means cultivating a thousand groves, each costing real effort and slashable stake, so a sybil flood costs more than it can ever earn back.
